questions.stem: An 8-year-old boy with a history of MDD treated with fluoxetine is brought to the pediatric emergency department after running into the street in front of a car on the way home from school. The boy says that he wants to be dead and refuses to say more. The boy was not hit by the car, and physical and laboratory examinations are normal.Which of the following symptoms of MDD is seen more commonly in children than in adolescents?
